Friday Saguaro East Ride

Tucson, AZ · Road

Friday Saguaro East Ride is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls every Friday at 7:30 am from La Herradura Mexican Grill. Pace: level B, 15 to 17 mph, in the club's own rating. 1,400 to 1,560 feet of climbing depending on the route..

For visitors

Guests sign up for a free Trial membership (one ride a year), sign the waiver and register for the ride on the club's site before they roll. The club's page says you must be a member to register. A and C riders can join at their own pace. The club cancels for weather by email, so check your email before you leave. Bring more water than you think. Post-ride social at LeBuzz.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 to 17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Saguaro East Ride group ride

Cactus Cycling Club's Friday morning loop around the east side of Saguaro National Park. The club rotates three routes of 32 to 34 miles and rates the ride Level B, 15 to 17 mph. Riders meet at La Herradura Mexican Grill on Tanque Verde Rd and have a drink at LeBuzz afterward.
